values.note: RV sites $49.50 a day for two; extra persons (6+) $5 a day each, 6 maximum; dogs $5 a day each for stays of a week or less. Monthly $960 on off-river sites only (no monthly river rates). 5% off for cash or check. Non-refundable deposit: $50 for one night, $100 for 2-7 nights.

note: Family-run (Frank and Kim O'Connor) campground on CO-17 between mile markers 18 and 19 west of Antonito, at 8,600 ft in Conejos Canyon beside the Conejos River, surrounded by national forest; also 6 cabins. Catch-and-release fly fishing on the property; OHV passes sold on site. All vehicles and trailers must fit within the site (otherwise $5 a day to park elsewhere by arrangement). --Claude
